***Update Mar 31 2021. Fixes minor bugs.

Orac module version of the 4wave patch for Organelle.

4wave is wavetable synthesizer with a waveform amplitude mixer. 

Create new timbres by mixing up to four waveforms together. As you turn Knobs1-4 from left to right, the amplitude of a waveform increases. When the amplitude reaches 100%, 200%, and 300%, the waveform frequency will double, triple, and quadruple respectively and the amplitude is reset to 0%. 

By adding different waveforms, amplitudes, and waveform frequencies together, 4wave is able to generate synthesis that is bright, growly, organ-like, and more! 

4-Voice polyphony.

Knob1: Sets amplitude and frequency of Wave 1
Knob2: Sets amplitude and frequency of Wave 2
Knob3: Sets amplitude and frequency of Wave 3
Knob4: Sets amplitude and frequency of Wave 4
